Module.Name: bi-export-plus
Module.Description: Real, binary .xlsx (and typed JSON) exports for the InterSystems IRIS BI/DeepSee Analyzer, replacing the legacy HTML-saved-as-.xls "Export to Excel" behavior. Adds "Excel Workbook" and "JSON" items to the Analyzer's own Export dropdown, plus a standalone REST API for external tools.
Module.AfterInstallMessage:
**************************************************************** Thanks for installing bi-export-plus!
To use the new "Excel Workbook"/"JSON" buttons in the Analyzer's own Export dropdown, open your pivots via BIExport.UI.Analyzer.cls instead of the stock _DeepSee.UI.Analyzer.zen (same query params, just a different class name) - see README.md, "Option A".
A standalone REST API was also registered at /csp/bi-export/xlsx and /csp/bi-export/json for external tools/scripts - see README.md, "Option B".
Requires IRIS Embedded Python with openpyxl importable (Do ##class(%SYS.Python).Import("openpyxl") to check) for the xlsx path specifically; JSON export needs neither. See README.md if that import fails. ****************************************************************
